Name: Dizor's Wizard Redraw for Content Patcher
Author: KatJustice97
Description:
Original description: I felt for as tall and thin as the Wizard's overworld sprite is, his portrait is awfully squat and dwarfish.
Ended up layering the old sprite behind the new one and liked the accidental wild hair look it gave over the previous straight hair I'd drawn, so this is the result.

--

This portrait was originally made as an XNB mod back in 2016. I wanted a light foray into learning how to make Content Patcher mods and got Dizor's permission to update this to work with it.

Enjoy!

--
